description: This command assigns group names to objects based on their relation to geometric sets. Use of the group logic is described in Groups . All polygons in all sets are assigned a surface number – polygons that are connected topologically will be assigned the same number. From the position of each object, a ray is projected in the direction specified by the projection keyword. FLAC3D will count the number of times that ray intersects each surface, and use that information to assign a group name.

keywords.name: data
keywords.syntax: data {scalar keyword | tensor keyword | vector keyword}
keywords.description: This assigns group names to the set of user-define data based on their location. Options: scalar keyword: Assign groups to the user-defined scalar data using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; tensor keyword: Assign groups to the user-defined tensors data using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; vector keyword: Assign groups to the user-defined vectors data using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).

keywords.name: structure
keywords.syntax: structure {beam keyword | cable keyword | geogrid keyword | liner keyword | link keyword | node keyword | pile keyword | shell keyword}
keywords.description: This assigns group names to structural data (elements, nodes, or links). Elements are checked at their centroids. Options: beam keyword: Assign groups to beams using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; cable keyword: Assign groups to cables using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; geogrid keyword: Assign groups to geogrids using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; liner keyword: Assign groups to liners using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; link keyword: Assign groups to links using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; node keyword: Assign groups to nodes using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; pile keyword: Assign groups to piles using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; shell keyword: Assign groups to shells using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).

keywords.name: zone
keywords.description: Assign groups to zones (or grid points if the option grid-point keyword is given) using a \(Type Block\) keyword.

keywords.name: projection
keywords.description: Specifies the direction the projection is made from each location considered. By default this direction is (0,0,1) .

keywords.name: set
keywords.description: Specifies the name of the set to use. More than one set name may be specified. By default, the current selected set is used.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Specifies the slot that the group names will be assigned in. If not specified the slot name is ‘Default’.
